subject.title: refactor: move non-session runtime journals to SQLite

question: Should OpenClaw adopt per-agent schema v11 and replace the documented ACP streamLogPath contract with a new permanent SQLite-backed inspection API?
rationale: Repository policy prohibits autonomous schema-version advancement, and implementation evidence cannot decide the permanent public diagnostics contract.

options.title: Preserve compatible access
options.body: Keep a supported ACP relay-history handle or accessor while changing internal storage, with migration and upgrade proof.

options.title: Approve a breaking replacement
options.body: Remove streamLogPath only after defining, documenting, and proving the replacement SQLite inspection contract.

options.title: Split ACP from the refactor
options.body: Land the lower-risk audit and memory journal migrations separately and defer the ACP schema and API decision.

recommendation.title: Preserve compatible access
recommendation.body: Keep a supported ACP relay-history handle or accessor while changing internal storage, with migration and upgrade proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged session/transcript SQLite work established the per-agent schema and lifecycle boundary this PR changes.
